[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fair, configurable store-lock waits in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]store_lock[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]store_lock: replace the 2s hardcoded try-lock poll in the Rust [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-mutation, task-store, and prompt-stash locks with a capped-backoff [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wait whose bound is a long, env-overridable default, and record holder [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity so an expired wait names its blocker.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable stage timing for sase bead work[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]work_timing[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]work_timing: promote the bead-work launch timer to a durable telemetry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sink, instrument the currently unmeasured plan-to-epic span, and warn on[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]slow stages so a multi-minute launch is attributable after the fact.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bounded and instrumented plan-launch and store-write locks[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]launch_lock[dim] · [dim][/dim]after work_timing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch_lock: give the unbounded epic-plan launch flock a deadline, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]holder identity, and an actionable expiry error, and record every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store-write-lock wait through the durable timing sink instead of only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]warning on fail-open.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Contention-resilient task and epic bead launches[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]launch_retry[dim] · [dim][/dim]after store_lock[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch_retry: classify store-lock expiry as a distinct retryable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failure, retry bead-work preclaims within a bounded budget, and report [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contention to the operator as a wait rather than a bare exit-code-1 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]error.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Concurrency regression coverage for bead launches[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]contention_tests[dim] · [dim][/dim]after store_lock, launch_lock, launch_retry[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]contention_tests: add regression tests that drive concurrent bead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mutations and a task launch overlapping an epic launch, asserting no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lock expiry and no half-claimed beads.[/#D7D7AF]
